value.syntax: # [doc = " Disjoint evaluated, exact and operational constructors of the second edition."] # [doc = " (´[ROOT-dec:design:comparison-verdict-record]´)"] # [derive (Clone , Debug , PartialEq , Eq)] pub enum ResultKind { # [doc = " A claim about the reduction's quantity, with its endpoint-derived verdict."] # [doc = " (´[ROOT-dec:design:comparison-verdict-record]´)"] Evaluated { reduction : u64 , predicate : u64 , enclosure : Enclosure , threshold : Fraction , relation : u64 , verdict : u64 , } , # [doc = " Original exact operands; no enclosure or mathematical indecision is invented."] # [doc = " (´[ROOT-dec:design:comparison-verdict-record]´)"] Exact { left : Fraction , predicate : u64 , right : Fraction , relation : u64 , verdict : u64 , } , # [doc = " An operational outcome has a cause and has no verdict."] # [doc = " (´[ROOT-dec:design:comparison-verdict-record]´)"] Operational { cause : u64 } , }
